mostWorthwhile.text: Repeated paired activity was the most worthwhile construction: the planned before-and-after panels distinguish a stronger local synaptic response from a larger travelling impulse.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding astrocytes felt less informative because the resulting picture shows them interwoven with circuits but does not show the potassium and transmitter uptake described on the opening board.

surprise.text: The receptor-vesicle inset suggested a mechanism for strengthening before the final comparison confirmed a larger local response to equal input.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, although attaching dendrites and axons as separate pieces simplified their development; the planned pictures did explain their roles.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the progression from converging inputs to a specific synaptic change connected the constructions to how signalling works, though the sequence was fairly predictable.
